title: RF Design Engineer (m/f/d)

descriptionByLocale.it:
Come RF Design Engineer, si svolgerà un ruolo chiave nello sviluppo della prossima generazione di tecnologie wireless che alimentano le nostre innovative soluzioni uditive. Lavorando all'interno del nostro team di Electronic Systems & RF, contribuirai alla progettazione, alla simulazione, alla validazione e all'ottimizzazione di piattaforme RF, antenne e sistemi di comunicazione wireless, dal primo sviluppo del concetto fino alla riuscita integrazione e certificazione del prodotto.

Collaborerai con team di ingegneria multidisciplinari e partner tecnologici esterni per trasformare concetti RF innovativi in prodotti ad alte prestazioni. In cambio, ti unirai a un ambiente internazionale di R&D in cui la collaborazione, la creatività e l'apprendimento continuo sono incoraggiati, dandoti l'opportunità di lavorare con tecnologie all'avanguardia, facendo un impatto significativo sulla vita di milioni di persone in tutto il mondo.

Ulteriori informazioni sul ruolo

• Definire le specifiche tecniche per le funzioni RF, compresi i circuiti RF e i sistemi antenna

• Progettazione, sviluppo e ottimizzazione di antenne PCB e circuiti RF dal concetto attraverso l'integrazione del prodotto

• Creare strategie di verifica, sviluppare piani di test e eseguire la convalida dei moduli RF per garantire prestazioni e affidabilità

• Eseguire simulazioni RF e valutare le prestazioni dell'antenna e del ricetrasmettitore utilizzando strumenti di simulazione leader del settore

• Supporta la progettazione, lo sviluppo e la verifica delle piattaforme di comunicazione wireless di nuova generazione

• Indagare, risolvere i problemi e risolvere le sfide delle prestazioni RF, tra cui EMI, conformità RF e problemi di integrazione a livello di sistema

• Gestire e sostenere le attività di certificazione RF coordinando con laboratori di test esterni e garantendo la qualificazione del prodotto di successo

• Collaborare con partner interni ed esterni su valutazioni tecnologiche, studi di fattibilità, iniziative di innovazione e futuro sviluppo delle piattaforme wireless

Più di te

• Laurea magistrale in Elettronica, Ingegneria Elettrica, Telecomunicazioni o disciplina correlata

• Esperienza dimostrata nella progettazione RF all'interno di un ambiente R&D, tra cui progettazione antenna, misurazioni RF e sviluppo del sistema wireless

• Forte competenza in strumenti di simulazione RF come ADS e CST Studio Suite

• Esperienza pratica con apparecchiature di laboratorio RF, tra cui gli analizzatori di rete Vector (VNA), gli analizzatori di spettro e i sistemi di misurazione dell'antenna

• Esperienza nella progettazione di circuiti elettronici analogici e soluzioni RF basate su PCB

• Familiarità con tecnologie di comunicazione wireless come Bluetooth, ISM (2.4 GHz), e sistemi wireless a bassa potenza

• L'esperienza con MATLAB e Altium Designer è considerata un vantaggio

• Forte capacità analitiche e problem solving con una mentalità strutturata e orientata alla soluzione

• Fluente scritto e parlato inglese; tedesco o francese sarebbe un bene

Maggiori informazioni su ciò che offriamo

Essendo uno dei principali fornitori di servizi per l'udito con sede in Svizzera, ci impegniamo a costruire una cultura inclusiva. Vogliamo creare un ambiente in cui è possibile bilanciare una carriera di successo con i vostri impegni e interessi al di fuori del lavoro attraverso il nostro modello di lavoro ibrido flessibile.

Avrete accesso a tecnologie R&D all'avanguardia, opportunità di collaborazione internazionale e una vasta gamma di programmi di sviluppo professionale e personale. Sosteniamo la vostra crescita attraverso i piani di sviluppo individuali e incoraggiamo l'innovazione in ogni fase della vostra carriera.

descriptionByLocale.en:
As an RF Design Engineer, you will play a key role in developing the next generation of wireless technologies that power our innovative hearing solutions. Working within our Electronic Systems & RF team, you will contribute to the design, simulation, validation, and optimization of RF platforms, antennas, and wireless communication systems—from early concept development through to successful product integration and certification.

You'll collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams and external technology partners to transform innovative RF concepts into high-performance products. In return, you'll join an international R&D environment where collaboration, creativity, and continuous learning are encouraged, giving you the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies while making a meaningful impact on the lives of millions of people worldwide.

More about the role

• Define technical specifications for RF functions, including RF circuits and antenna systems

• Design, develop, and optimize PCB antennas and RF circuits from concept through product integration

• Create verification strategies, develop test plans, and perform validation of RF modules to ensure performance and reliability

• Perform RF simulations and evaluate antenna and transceiver performance using industry-leading simulation tools

• Support the design, development, and verification of next-generation wireless communication platforms

• Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve RF performance challenges, including EMI, RF compliance, and system-level integration issues

• Manage and support RF certification activities by coordinating with external test laboratories and ensuring successful product qualification

• Collaborate with internal and external partners on technology assessments, feasibility studies, innovation initiatives, and future wireless platform development

More about you

• Master's degree in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications, or a related discipline

• Proven experience in RF design within an R&D environment, including antenna design, RF measurements, and wireless system development

• Strong expertise in RF simulation tools such as ADS and CST Studio Suite

• Hands-on experience with RF laboratory equipment, including Vector Network Analyzers (VNA), Spectrum Analyzers, and antenna measurement systems

• Experience designing analog electronic circuits and PCB-based RF solutions

• Familiarity with wireless communication technologies such as Bluetooth, ISM (2.4 GHz), and low-power wireless systems

• Experience with MATLAB and Altium Designer is considered an advantage

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a structured and solution-oriented mindset

• Fluent written and spoken English; German or French would be an asset

More about what we offer

As one of the world's leading hearing care providers headquartered in Switzerland, we're committed to building an inclusive culture. We want to create an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work through our flexible hybrid working model.

You'll have access to cutting-edge R&D technologies, international collaboration opportunities, and a wide range of professional and personal development programs. We support your growth through individual development plans and encourage innovation at every stage of your career.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Als RF Design Engineer spielen Sie eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Entwicklung der nächsten Generation von drahtlosen Technologien, die unsere innovativen Hörlösungen unterstützen. In unserem Electronic Systems & RF-Team tragen Sie zur Gestaltung, Simulation, Validierung und Optimierung von RF-Plattformen, Antennen und drahtlosen Kommunikationssystemen bei - von der frühen Konzeptentwicklung bis hin zur erfolgreichen Produktintegration und -zertifizierung.

Sie arbeiten mit multidisziplinären Ingenieurteams und externen Technologiepartnern zusammen, um innovative RF-Konzepte in Hochleistungsprodukte umzuwandeln. Im Gegenzug treten Sie einer internationalen F & E-Umgebung bei, in der Zusammenarbeit, Kreativität und kontinuierliches Lernen gefördert werden, was Ihnen die Möglichkeit gibt, mit innovativen Technologien zu arbeiten und gleichzeitig das Leben von Millionen von Menschen weltweit sinnvoll zu beeinflussen.

Mehr über die Rolle

• Festlegung technischer Spezifikationen für HF-Funktionen, einschließlich HF-Schaltungen und Antennensysteme

• Entwurf, Entwicklung und Optimierung von Leiterplattenantennen und HF-Schaltungen vom Konzept bis zur Produktintegration

• Erstellen Sie Verifizierungsstrategien, entwickeln Sie Testpläne und führen Sie die Validierung von HF-Modulen durch, um Leistung und Zuverlässigkeit zu gewährleisten

• Führen Sie RF-Simulationen durch und bewerten Sie die Antennen- und Transceiver-Leistung mit branchenführenden Simulationstools

• Unterstützung von Design, Entwicklung und Verifizierung von drahtlosen Kommunikationsplattformen der nächsten Generation

• Untersuchen, Beheben und Beheben von RF-Leistungsherausforderungen, einschließlich EMI-, RF-Compliance- und Systemintegrationsproblemen

• Verwaltung und Unterstützung von RF-Zertifizierungsaktivitäten durch Koordination mit externen Testlabors und Sicherstellung einer erfolgreichen Produktqualifizierung

• Zusammenarbeit mit internen und externen Partnern bei Technologiebewertungen, Machbarkeitsstudien, Innovationsinitiativen und der zukünftigen Entwicklung drahtloser Plattformen

Mehr über dich

• Master-Abschluss in Elektronik, Elektrotechnik, Telekommunikation oder einer verwandten Disziplin

• Bewährte Erfahrung im HF-Design in einer F & E-Umgebung, einschließlich Antennendesign, HF-Messungen und Entwicklung drahtloser Systeme

• Starke Expertise in HF-Simulationstools wie ADS und CST Studio Suite

• Praktische Erfahrung mit RF-Laborgeräten, einschließlich Vector Network Analyzers (VNA), Spectrum Analyzers und Antennenmesssystemen

• Erfahrung beim Entwerfen von analogen elektronischen Schaltungen und PCB-basierten RF-Lösungen

• Vertrautheit mit drahtlosen Kommunikationstechnologien wie Bluetooth, ISM (2,4 GHz) und drahtlosen Systemen mit geringem Stromverbrauch

• Erfahrung mit MATLAB und Altium Designer gilt als Vorteil

• Starke analytische und problemlösende Fähigkeiten mit einer strukturierten und lösungsorientierten Denkweise

• fließend geschriebenes und gesprochenes Englisch; Deutsch oder Französisch wäre ein Vermögenswert

Mehr über das, was wir anbieten

Als einer der weltweit führenden Hörgeräteanbieter mit Hauptsitz in der Schweiz engagieren wir uns für den Aufbau einer inklusiven Kultur. Wir möchten ein Umfeld schaffen, in dem Sie eine erfolgreiche Karriere mit Ihren Verpflichtungen und Interessen außerhalb der Arbeit durch unser flexibles hybrides Arbeitsmodell in Einklang bringen können.

Sie haben Zugang zu innovativen F & E-Technologien, internationalen Kooperationsmöglichkeiten und einer breiten Palette von professionellen und persönlichen Entwicklungsprogrammen. Wir unterstützen Ihr Wachstum durch individuelle Entwicklungspläne und fördern Innovationen in jeder Phase Ihrer Karriere.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
En tant qu'ingénieur en conception RF, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans le développement de la prochaine génération de technologies sans fil qui alimentent nos solutions auditives innovantes. En travaillant au sein de notre équipe Systèmes électroniques et RF, vous contribuerez à la conception, à la simulation, à la validation et à l'optimisation des plates-formes RF, des antennes et des systèmes de communication sans fil, depuis l'élaboration des concepts jusqu'à l'intégration et la certification réussies des produits.

Vous collaborerez avec des équipes d'ingénierie multidisciplinaires et des partenaires technologiques externes pour transformer des concepts RF innovants en produits de haute performance. En retour, vous rejoindrez un environnement international de R-D où la collaboration, la créativité et l'apprentissage continu sont encouragés, vous donnant la possibilité de travailler avec des technologies de pointe tout en ayant un impact significatif sur la vie de millions de personnes dans le monde.

En savoir plus sur le rôle

• Définir les spécifications techniques pour les fonctions RF, y compris les circuits RF et les systèmes d'antenne

• Concevoir, développer et optimiser les antennes PCB et les circuits RF du concept à l'intégration des produits

• Créer des stratégies de vérification, élaborer des plans d'essai et effectuer la validation des modules RF pour assurer la performance et la fiabilité

• Effectuer des simulations RF et évaluer la performance des antennes et des émetteurs à l'aide d'outils de simulation de pointe

• Soutenir la conception, le développement et la vérification des plateformes de communication sans fil de nouvelle génération

• Enquêter, dépanner et résoudre les problèmes de performance des RF, y compris l'IME, la conformité aux RF et les questions d'intégration au niveau du système

• Gérer et soutenir les activités de certification RF en coordonnant avec les laboratoires d'essais externes et en assurant la qualification réussie des produits

• Collaborer avec des partenaires internes et externes à l'évaluation des technologies, aux études de faisabilité, aux initiatives d'innovation et au développement de futures plateformes sans fil

Plus sur vous

• Maîtrise en électronique, génie électrique, télécommunications ou discipline connexe

• Expérience éprouvée en conception RF dans un environnement de R-D, y compris la conception d'antennes, les mesures RF et le développement de systèmes sans fil

• Une solide expertise dans les outils de simulation RF comme ADS et CST Studio Suite

• Expérience pratique de l'équipement de laboratoire RF, y compris les analyseurs de réseau vectorielle (VNA), les analyseurs de spectre et les systèmes de mesure d'antenne

• Expérience de conception de circuits électroniques analogiques et de solutions RF basées sur PCB

• Familiarité avec les technologies de communication sans fil comme Bluetooth, ISM (2,4 GHz) et les systèmes sans fil de faible puissance

• Expérience avec MATLAB et Altium Designer est considéré comme un avantage

• Fortes compétences analytiques et de résolution de problèmes avec une mentalité structurée et orientée vers la solution

• L'anglais écrit et parlé; l'allemand ou le français serait un atout

Plus sur ce que nous offrons

En tant que l'un des principaux fournisseurs de soins auditifs au monde ayant leur siège en Suisse, nous nous engageons à bâtir une culture inclusive. Nous voulons créer un environnement où vous pouvez équilibrer une carrière réussie avec vos engagements et vos intérêts en dehors du travail grâce à notre modèle de travail hybride flexible.

Vous aurez accès à des technologies de pointe en R-D, à des possibilités de collaboration internationale et à une vaste gamme de programmes de perfectionnement professionnel et personnel. Nous soutenons votre croissance à travers des plans de développement individuels et encourageons l'innovation à chaque étape de votre carrière.

title: Patent Engineer (80%-100%) (m/f/d)

descriptionByLocale.it:
In this role, you will become a key partner to inventors, technical experts, patent attorneys and internal stakeholders and an important member of the Patent and Design Rights Team located at the headquarters in Staefa, Switzerland. You will actively contribute to shaping and protecting inventions in the field of hearing devices by supporting the full lifecycle of intellectual property activities. You will coordinate and help drive a variety of IP-related processes, ensuring that ideas are captured, evaluated, and transformed into strong patent and design protections. Working closely with inventors, you will play an essential role in turning innovation into valuable IP assets. In this role you will:
• Support inventors and patent attorneys from initial ideas generation and invention disclosures preparation through patent prosecution and into maintenance and enforcement decisions
• Review patent publications of in the field of hearing systems and prepare IP landscapes
• Provide IP training to inventors, technical patent experts and business partners
• Assist with administrative, organizational and accounting tasks for the Patent and Design Rights Team More about you:
• Degree in electrical engineering, physics, or equivalent work experience and a background in at least one of the following technical fields: wireless communication, signal processing and neural networks
• Corporate experience in international patent practice or project management
• Strong ability to extract and communicate technical and legal concepts clearly and concisely
• Ability to identify, review, and explain patent-related matters and provide IP advice to internal stakeholders Experience in searching and retrieving information from IP databases and registers
• Excellent written and spoken English and German language skills More about what we offer As one of the world’s leading hearing care providers headquartered in Switzerland, we are committed to building an inclusive culture where you can balance a successful career with your life outside of work through our flexible hybrid working model. We offer a wide range of training opportunities for both professional and personal development, with strong growth opportunities supported by individual development plans. Application process Magdalena Suszek, Talent Acquisition Partner, is looking forward to receiving your application via our online job application platform, including your CV and cover letter. For this vacancy, only direct applications will be considered. <div dir="auto" style=" width:calc(100% - 16px) !important;"

title: Senior Project Manager (m/f/d)

descriptionByLocale.it:
Condurre lo sviluppo di soluzioni acustiche innovative dal concept al mercato A Sonova, sviluppiamo soluzioni per l'udito innovative che migliorano la qualità della vita per milioni di persone in tutto il mondo. Come Senior Project Manager, guiderai progetti R&D complessi e multidisciplinari attraverso dispositivi acustici, applicazioni software e relativi accessori. Lavorando all'intersezione dell'ingegneria, del software incorporato e dell'innovazione di prodotto, guiderete i progetti dal concept attraverso la consegna di prodotti di successo, garantendo l'allineamento su portata, qualità, tempi e budget, aiutando a portare al mercato le soluzioni uditive di nuova generazione. Ulteriori informazioni sul ruolo
• Leader team di progetto R&D multidisciplinari, guidando lo sviluppo e la consegna di dispositivi acustici innovativi, applicazioni software e accessori.
• Campo di applicazione del proprio progetto, linee temporali, bilancio, risorse e rischi, garantendo la consegna di successo attraverso una pianificazione efficace, la governance e l'esecuzione di stage-gate.
• Costruire partnership forti tra ingegneria, sviluppo del software e altre funzioni aziendali, gestione delle parti interessate, dipendenze cross-project e decisioni chiave del progetto.
• Preparare e presentare gli aggiornamenti del progetto ai comitati di guida, assicurando trasparenza, governance efficace e decisionale informato.
• Sviluppare e mantenere piani di progetto e documentazione in linea con gli standard di gestione del progetto di Sonova e i processi di gestione del portafoglio.
• Valutazioni della tecnologia di azionamento, pianificazione dell'affidabilità e prontezza del progetto, sostenendo le attività di innovazione durante il ciclo di vita di sviluppo del prodotto.
• Identificare, valutare e gestire proattivamente i rischi, i vincoli e le dipendenze del progetto per consentire risultati di successo.
• Promuovere una cultura di team collaborativa e di alto livello focalizzata sulla qualità, l'innovazione e il miglioramento continuo. Più di te Devo
• Laurea o Master in Ingegneria o un'altra disciplina tecnica rilevante.
• 5+ anni di esperienza nell'ingegneria o nello sviluppo del prodotto, idealmente all'interno dell'industria del dispositivo medico o in un altro ambiente altamente regolamentato.
• 3+ anni di esperienza leader complessi, progetti di sviluppo di prodotti multidisciplinari dal concetto alla consegna.
• Forte competenza di gestione del progetto, tra cui pianificazione, gestione delle parti interessate, gestione del rischio, bilancio e governance del progetto.
• Prove capacità di guidare team interfunzionali, navigare complessità e guidare il processo decisionale informato in un ambiente globale.
• Ottima comunicazione, facilitazione e capacità di problem solving con la capacità di influenzare i diversi stakeholder.
• Competenze fluenti in inglese. Che bello avere
• Certificazione Project Management (PMP o equivalente).
• Esperienza all'interno dell'industria dell'udito o del dispositivo medico.
• Esperienza con Planisware, Jira, Confluence o SAP. Vogliamo creare un ambiente in cui è possibile bilanciare una carriera di successo con i vostri impegni e interessi al di fuori del lavoro, attraverso il nostro modello di lavoro ibrido flessibile. Offriamo una vasta gamma di opportunità di formazione sia per il vostro sviluppo professionale che personale, e ci sono eccezionali opportunità di crescita con i piani di sviluppo individuali. descriptionByLocale.en:
Lead the development of innovative hearing solutions from concept to market At Sonova, we develop innovative hearing care solutions that improve the quality of life for millions of people worldwide. As a Senior Project Manager, you will lead complex, multidisciplinary R&D projects across hearing devices, software applications and related accessories. Working at the intersection of engineering, embedded software and product innovation, you will drive projects from concept through successful product delivery, ensuring alignment on scope, quality, timelines and budget while helping bring the next generation of hearing solutions to market. More about the role
• Lead multidisciplinary R&D project teams, driving the successful development and delivery of innovative hearing devices, software applications and accessories.
• Own project scope, timelines, budget, resources and risks, ensuring successful delivery through effective planning, governance and stage-gate execution.
• Build strong partnerships across engineering, software development and other business functions, managing stakeholders, cross-project dependencies and key project decisions.
• Prepare and present project updates to steering committees, ensuring transparency, effective governance and informed decision-making.
• Develop and maintain project plans and documentation in line with Sonova's project management standards and portfolio management processes.
• Drive technology assessments, reliability planning and project readiness while supporting innovation activities throughout the product development lifecycle.
• Identify, assess and proactively manage project risks, constraints and dependencies to enable successful project outcomes.
• Foster a collaborative, high-performing team culture focused on quality, innovation and continuous improvement. More about you Must have
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering or another relevant technical discipline.
• 5+ years of experience in engineering or product development, ideally within the medical device industry or another highly regulated environment.
• 3+ years of experience leading complex, multidisciplinary product development projects from concept to delivery.
• Strong project management expertise, including planning, stakeholder management, risk management, budgeting and project governance.
• Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams, navigate complexity and drive informed decision-making in a global environment.
• Excellent communication, facilitation and problem-solving skills with the ability to influence diverse stakeholders.
• Fluent English skills. Nice to have
• Project Management certification (PMP or equivalent).
• Experience within the hearing care or medical device industry.
• Experience with Planisware, Jira, Confluence or SAP. More about what we offer As one of the world’s leading hearing care providers headquartered in Switzerland, we’re committed to building an inclusive culture. We want to create an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work, through our flexible hybrid working model. We offer a wide range of training opportunities for both your professional and personal development, and there are exceptional growth opportunities with individual development plans. descriptionByLocale.it:
Shape the technology behind the future of hearing care At Sonova, we develop innovative hearing solutions that improve the quality of life for millions of people around the world. Behind every successful product is a portfolio of technologies and components that enable exceptional performance, reliability, and user experience. To strengthen our R&D organization, we are looking for a Senior Components Manager who combines technical understanding, strategic thinking, and stakeholder management skills. In this role, you will own a portfolio of key components throughout their entire lifecycle and help define the technologies that power Sonova’s future solutions. More about the role As a Senior Components Manager , you will own assigned components throughout their entire lifecycle, ensuring they remain competitive and support Sonova's future product and technology strategies. • Balancing and aligning Marketing, Technology, and Component Development needs to identify the right compromises and priorities
• Ensuring Sonova maintains a competitive component portfolio that supports future solution and product development
• Driving the adoption and reuse of components across multiple products and offerings
• Collaborating closely with Marketing functions, Component Development teams, and Technology & Function organizations to deliver successful component solutions
• Acting as the central point of ownership and coordination for assigned components across the organization More about you
• A degree in Engineering, Technology, Physics, Electronics, Systems Engineering, Product Development, or a related field
• Several years of experience in engineering, R&D, or technical product development, combined with exposure to product management, product marketing, technology strategy, or customer/market-driven requirement definition
• Experience in medical devices, hearing technology, consumer electronics, telecommunications, automotive, or other highly regulated industries
• Experience working in cross-functional product development environments
• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
• Energy, curiosity, and a strong sense of ownership. Proactively driving topics forward, embracing challenges, and taking accountability for achieving results, even when solutions require balancing competing priorities and navigating uncertainty.
• The ability to balance technical possibilities with customer and business needs
• Ability to leverage AI for better output and efficiency through advanced prompting
• Fluent English communication skills; good German language skills are considered an asset More about what we offer: As one of the world’s leading hearing care providers headquartered in Switzerland, we’re committed to building an inclusive culture. title: Data Scientist (m/f/d)

descriptionByLocale.it:
In qualità di Data Scientist, trasformerai i dati reali su larga scala in approfondimenti significativi che migliorano i prodotti, i viaggi dei pazienti e le decisioni aziendali. Lavorando in un ambiente R&D interdisciplinare e agile, collaborerai a stretto contatto con ingegneri, product manager, product marketing e stakeholder aziendali per sviluppare soluzioni innovative basate sui dati per l'industria dell'udito. In cambio, avrete l'opportunità di lavorare con tecnologie all'avanguardia, modellare le future soluzioni MedTech e contribuire a prodotti che migliorano la vita di milioni di persone in tutto il mondo. Ulteriori informazioni sul ruolo
• Traduci i requisiti aziendali e degli stakeholder in soluzioni di analisi e digitalizzazione basate sui dati che supportano il processo decisionale strategico.
• Sviluppa modelli di machine learning e analisi avanzate utilizzando dati di prodotto reali su larga scala per migliorare prodotti, applicazioni e esperienze dei clienti.
• Applicare metodi statistici e tecniche di AI per i set di dati relativi alla salute per generare intuizioni cliniche e aziendali attuabili.
• Analizzare il comportamento dell'utente e i dati di utilizzo del prodotto per comprendere meglio le esigenze dei clienti, le preferenze e i viaggi dei pazienti.
• Sostenere lo sviluppo, la governance e la manutenzione dei cataloghi dati e dei beni dati.
• Collaborare a stretto contatto con R&D interdisciplinare, ingegneria, gestione dei prodotti e team aziendali in un ambiente agile.
• Resta aggiornato con gli ultimi sviluppi in data science, machine learning e AI, identificando le opportunità di tradurre l'innovazione in caratteristiche di prodotto e valore aziendale. Più di te
• Laurea magistrale in Data Science, Ingegneria, Informatica, o un campo correlato; PhD è un vantaggio.
• 4+ anni di esperienza nel settore come Data Scientist o in un ruolo analitico simile.
• Forte competenza nell'apprendimento automatico, nelle statistiche, nella modellazione predittiva e nell'analisi dei dati.
• Esperienza pratica con Python, Databricks, Azure o piattaforme di analisi basate su cloud comparabili.
• Esperienza di lavoro con set di dati su larga scala, datadotti e moderne architetture di dati.
• L'esperienza all'interno di MedTech, salute, farmaci o un campo scientifico correlato come la psicologia, l'audiologia o le scienze della salute è altamente auspicabile.
• Forte mentalità analitica con eccellenti capacità di comunicazione e la capacità di tradurre analisi complesse in raccomandazioni attuabili per gli stakeholder tecnici e non tecnici.
• Passione per l'innovazione con un forte interesse nell'applicare gli ultimi sviluppi dell'IA alle sfide sanitarie del mondo reale.
• Fluente in inglese, sia scritto che parlato. Maggiori informazioni su ciò che offriamo Come uno dei principali fornitori di servizi per l’udito con sede in Svizzera, ci impegniamo a costruire una cultura inclusiva. Vogliamo creare un ambiente in cui è possibile bilanciare una carriera di successo con i vostri impegni e interessi al di fuori del lavoro, attraverso il nostro modello di lavoro ibrido flessibile. Offriamo una vasta gamma di opportunità di formazione sia per il vostro sviluppo professionale che personale, e ci sono eccezionali opportunità di crescita con i piani di sviluppo individuali. <div dir="auto" style=" larghezza:calc(100% - 16px)
descriptionByLocale.en:
As a Data Scientist, you will transform large-scale real-world data into meaningful insights that improve products, patient journeys, and business decisions. Working within an interdisciplinary, agile R&D environment, you will collaborate closely with engineers, product managers, product marketing, and business stakeholders to develop innovative data-driven solutions for the hearing care industry. In return, you will have the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies, shape future MedTech solutions, and contribute to products that improve the lives of millions of people worldwide. More about the role
• Translate business and stakeholder requirements into data-driven analytics and digital solutions that support strategic decision-making.
• Develop machine learning models and advanced analytics using large-scale real-world product data to enhance products, applications, and customer experiences.
• Apply statistical methods and AI techniques to health-related datasets to generate actionable clinical and business insights.
• Analyze user behavior and product usage data to better understand customer needs, preferences, and patient journeys.
• Support the development, governance, and maintenance of data catalogues and data assets.
• Collaborate closely with interdisciplinary R&D, engineering, product management, and business teams in an agile environment.
• Stay up to date with the latest developments in data science, machine learning, and AI, identifying opportunities to translate innovation into product features and business value. More about you
• Master's degree in Data Science, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field; PhD is an advantage.
• 4+ years of industry experience as a Data Scientist or in a similar analytical role.
• Strong expertise in machine learning, statistics, predictive modelling, and data analysis.
• Hands-on experience with Python, Databricks, Azure, or comparable cloud-based analytics platforms.
• Experience working with large-scale datasets, data pipelines, and modern data architectures.
• Experience within MedTech, healthcare, pharma, or a related scientific field such as psychology, audiology, or health sciences is highly desirable.
• Strong analytical mindset with excellent communication skills and the ability to translate complex analyses into actionable recommendations for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Passion for innovation with a strong interest in applying the latest AI developments to real-world healthcare challenges.
• Fluent in English, both written and spoken. More about what we offer As one of the world’s leading hearing care providers headquartered in Switzerland, we’re committed to building an inclusive culture. We want to create an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work, through our flexible hybrid working model. We offer a wide range of training opportunities for both your professional and personal development, and there are exceptional growth opportunities with individual development plans. <div dir="auto" style=" width:calc(100% - 16px) !important;"

Als Data Scientist verwandeln Sie große reale Daten in sinnvolle Erkenntnisse, die Produkte, Patientenreisen und Geschäftsentscheidungen verbessern. In einem interdisziplinären, agilen F & E-Umfeld arbeiten Sie eng mit Ingenieuren, Produktmanagern, Produktmarketing und Geschäftsinteressenten zusammen, um innovative datengesteuerte Lösungen für die Hörgerätebranche zu entwickeln. Im Gegenzug haben Sie die Möglichkeit, mit innovativen Technologien zu arbeiten, zukünftige MedTech-Lösungen zu gestalten und zu Produkten beizutragen, die das Leben von Millionen von Menschen weltweit verbessern. Mehr über die Rolle
• Übersetzen Sie Geschäfts- und Stakeholderanforderungen in datengesteuerte Analysen und digitale Lösungen, die strategische Entscheidungen unterstützen.
• Entwickeln Sie Machine-Learning-Modelle und fortschrittliche Analysen mithilfe von großen realen Produktdaten, um Produkte, Anwendungen und Kundenerfahrungen zu verbessern.
• Wenden Sie statistische Methoden und KI-Techniken auf gesundheitsbezogene Datensätze an, um umsetzbare klinische und geschäftliche Erkenntnisse zu generieren.
• Analysieren Sie das Nutzerverhalten und die Produktnutzungsdaten, um Kundenbedürfnisse, Präferenzen und Patientenreisen besser zu verstehen.
• Unterstützung der Entwicklung, Governance und Pflege von Datenkatalogen und Datenbeständen.
• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit interdisziplinären F&E-, Engineering-, Produktmanagement- und Business-Teams in einem agilen Umfeld.
• Bleiben Sie auf dem Laufenden über die neuesten Entwicklungen in den Bereichen Data Science, Machine Learning und KI und identifizieren Sie Möglichkeiten, Innovationen in Produkteigenschaften und Geschäftswert umzusetzen. Mehr über dich
• Master-Abschluss in Data Science, Engineering, Informatik oder einem verwandten Bereich; PhD ist ein Vorteil.
• 4+ Jahre Industrieerfahrung als Data Scientist oder in einer ähnlichen analytischen Rolle.
• Starke Expertise in den Bereichen maschinelles Lernen, Statistik, prädiktive Modellierung und Datenanalyse.
• Praktische Erfahrung mit Python, Databricks, Azure oder vergleichbaren Cloud-basierten Analyseplattformen.
• Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit großen Datensätzen, Datenpipelines und modernen Datenarchitekturen.
• Erfahrung in MedTech, Gesundheitswesen, Pharma oder einem verwandten wissenschaftlichen Bereich wie Psychologie, Audiologie oder Gesundheitswissenschaften ist sehr wünschenswert.
• Starke analytische Denkweise mit hervorragenden Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und der Fähigkeit, komplexe Analysen in umsetzbare Empfehlungen für technische und nicht-technische Stakeholder zu übersetzen.
• Leidenschaft für Innovationen mit einem starken Interesse daran, die neuesten KI-Entwicklungen auf reale Herausforderungen im Gesundheitswesen anzuwenden.
• fließend Englisch, sowohl geschrieben als auch gesprochen. Mehr über das, was wir anbieten Als einer der weltweit führenden Hörgeräteanbieter mit Hauptsitz in der Schweiz engagieren wir uns für den Aufbau einer inklusiven Kultur. Wir möchten ein Umfeld schaffen, in dem Sie eine erfolgreiche Karriere mit Ihren Verpflichtungen und Interessen außerhalb der Arbeit durch unser flexibles hybrides Arbeitsmodell in Einklang bringen können. Wir bieten eine breite Palette von Ausbildungsmöglichkeiten für Ihre berufliche und persönliche Entwicklung, und es gibt außergewöhnliche Wachstumsmöglichkeiten mit individuellen Entwicklungsplänen. <div dir="auto" style=" width:calc(100% - 16px) !wichtig;"

title: Junior Embedded Software Engineer (m/f/d)

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sonova Communications AG, situata a Murten, è una società del Gruppo Sonova. Siamo il leader del mercato globale e il centro di competenza di Sonova per i sistemi di comunicazione wireless ultra-miniaturizzati. Il nostro portafoglio prodotti spazia dai dispositivi di comunicazione per le persone con disabilità uditive alle soluzioni di comunicazione professionale per applicazioni di sicurezza, industria e broadcast. In questo ruolo, sarete responsabili per la progettazione e l'implementazione di software integrato per dispositivi di comunicazione wireless. Se siete interessati ad unire un team agile, guidato e collaborativo e contribuire alle vostre competenze tecniche e passione per il successo del nostro business, non vediamo l'ora della vostra applicazione.
• Specificare, implementare e testare i protocolli senza fili e il firmware sui sistemi incorporati basati su risorse, con i test che occupano la maggior parte dello sforzo
• Integrazione continua e sviluppo guidato da test su piattaforme hardware dedicate
• Programmazione in C e Python in un ambiente di sistemi incorporati
• Creazione di note tecniche e documentazione Livello di occupazione 80-100%. <div dir="auto" style=" larghezza:calc(100% - 16px)
descriptionByLocale.en:
Sonova Communications AG, located in Murten, is a company of the Sonova Group. We are the global market leader and Sonova’s competence center for ultra-miniaturized wireless communication systems. Our product portfolio ranges from communication devices for people with hearing impairments to professional communication solutions for security, industry, and broadcast applications. In this role, you will be responsible for the design and implementation of embedded software for wireless communication devices. If you are interested in joining an agile, driven, and collaborative team and contributing your technical skills and passion to the success of our business, we look forward to your application. More about the role
• Specification, implementation, and testing of wireless protocols and firmware on resource-constrained embedded systems, with testing occupying the bulk of the effort
• Continuous integration and test-driven development on dedicated hardware platforms
• Programming in C and Python in an embedded systems environment
• Creation of technical notes and documentation More about you
• BSc in Computer Science or Electrical / Electronic Engineering with strong programming skills
• Proficient in C for resource-constrained embedded systems and Python scripting
• Knowledge of hardware debugging tools such as oscilloscope, logic analyzer, etc.
• Experience working with Git version control in a team environment
• Interest in wireless communication protocols is an advantage
• Structured and quality-oriented mindset with a focus on testing and reliability
• Ability to work in a dynamic, agile environment

descriptionByLocale.it:
In dieser Funktion bist du als Technischer Spezialist Produktion TSP (m/w/d) ein zentraler Bestandteil unseres Support-Teams in der Elektronikfertigung. Du stellst die Anlagenverfügbarkeit durch vorbeugende Wartung sicher, minimierst Stillstände durch nachhaltige Instandhaltungsstrategien und behebst Störungen inklusive Ursachenanalyse. Dabei treibst du kontinuierliche Verbesserungen im Bereich Maintenance voran und entwickelst deine Fachkenntnisse (z. B. im TPS) stetig weiter. Als technische Schnittstelle zwischen Produktion, Engineering und Entwicklung unterstützt du die Fachbereiche, berätst bei technischen Fragestellungen und wirkst an der Optimierung unserer Anlagen mit. Mehr über die Rolle
• Sicherstellung der Anlagenverfügbarkeit durch vorbeugende Wartung von Anlagen, Betriebs- und Prüfmitteln
• Minimierung von Stillständen durch nachhaltige Instandhaltungsstrategien und Unterstützung der Maschinenbediener bei grundlegenden Wartungsaufgaben
• Analyse und Behebung von Störungen in der Produktion inklusive Ursachenanalyse
• Kontinuierliche Verbesserung (Continuous Improvement) im Bereich Maintenance
• Technische Schnittstelle zwischen Produktion, Engineering, Entwicklung sowie weiteren Fachbereichen (R&D, NPI, B&I)
• Technische Beratung und Unterstützung der Produktionsabteilungen sowie Mitwirkung bei der Optimierung von Anlagen
• Koordination, Dokumentation und Überwachung von Instandhaltungsmaßnahmen (inkl. LEXA) sowie Einhaltung von Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsvorschriften
• Verwaltung und Beschaffung von Ersatzteilen sowie Unterstützung bei der Weiterentwicklung automatisierter Anlagen und Pikettdienst bei Bedarf Mehr über dich
• Abgeschlossene technische Berufsbildung (EFZ) im elektronischen Bereich (z. B. Automatiker, Polymechaniker, Elektroniker)
• Erfahrung in der Elektronikproduktion, idealerweise mit Kenntnissen in Lean Management, Supply Chain und SMD/Flip-Chip-Bestückung
• Gute Übersicht über die gesamte Produktionskette sowie idealerweise Erfahrung in der Automatisierung oder Halbleiterfertigung
• Ausgeprägtes technisches Verständnis, schnelle Auffassungsgabe und bereichsübergreifendes Denken
• Hohes Qualitätsbewusstsein sowie strukturierte und verantwortungsvolle Arbeitsweise
• Erfahrung in der Durchführung von Schulungen sowie in der Einhaltung von Prozessen und Qualitätsstandards
• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
• Gute PC-Anwenderkenntnisse (MS Office 365); SAP-Kenntnisse von Vorteil Mehr über unser Angebot Als eines der weltweit führenden Unternehmen im Bereich Hörlösungen mit Hauptsitz in der Schweiz legen wir großen Wert auf eine inklusive und wertschätzende Unternehmenskultur. Wir bieten dir:
• Strukturierte Einarbeitung sowie gezielte interne und externe Weiterbildungen
• Individuelle Entwicklungs- und Wachstumsmöglichkeiten
• Ein modernes Produktionsumfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswege
• Die Möglichkeit, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und Prozesse aktiv mitzugestalten <div dir="auto" style=" width:calc(100% - 16px) !important;"

title: Director R&D Process Excellence

descriptionByLocale.it:
We are looking for a strategic and influential leader to join our global R&D organization as Director Group R&D Process Excellence . In this role, you will define and drive the vision for process excellence across our international R&D network, enabling teams to innovate faster, collaborate more effectively, and deliver high-quality solutions in a scalable and compliant way. You will work at the intersection of engineering, portfolio management, quality, regulatory affairs, and operations, helping to build an environment where continuous improvement is embedded into everyday decision-making. What you'll do
• Develop and execute the global strategy and roadmap for R&D process excellence across multiple sites.
• Establish governance, standards, and best practices that create consistency while enabling local flexibility where appropriate.
• Lead the portfolio of process improvement initiatives, ensuring investments are aligned with business priorities and deliver measurable value.
• Coach and advise senior R&D leaders on process performance, continuous improvement, and organizational effectiveness.
• Define and monitor key performance indicators, using data and insights to identify opportunities and guide strategic decisions.
• Facilitate cross-functional collaboration with Quality, Regulatory, PMO, IT, and Operations to optimize end-to-end product development processes.
• Champion methodologies such as Lean, Six Sigma, and Stage-Gate to build sustainable process excellence capabilities across the organization.
• Ensure R&D processes support compliance, audit readiness, technology transfer, scalability, and future business growth.
• Foster a culture of innovation and continuous improvement while leveraging modern technologies, including AI-enabled ways of working. What you bring
• Master's degree in Engineering, Business, or a related discipline.
• Significant leadership experience in process excellence, business transformation, or operational improvement within an engineering or R&D environment.
• Proven ability to design, implement, and optimize complex cross-functional processes at a global level.
• Experience leading change initiatives and influencing senior stakeholders across multiple functions and locations.
• Strong analytical skills with the ability to define meaningful KPIs and translate data into actionable improvements.
• Excellent facilitation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
• Hands-on experience with continuous improvement methodologies such as Lean, Six Sigma, or similar frameworks.
• Fluency in English. Nice to have
• Experience in the medical technology or other highly regulated industries.
• Additional education in business administration or project management.
• Familiarity with enterprise project portfolio management and SAP-based environments.
• Experience applying AI tools to improve productivity and business processes. Why join us? This is a unique opportunity to influence how a global R&D organization operates and innovates. You'll partner with senior leaders, shape strategic initiatives, and create lasting impact by building processes that enable teams to deliver breakthrough technologies more efficiently and effectively. If you're passionate about continuous improvement, enjoy solving complex organizational challenges, and thrive in collaborative international environments, we'd love to hear from you. <div dir="auto" style=" width:calc(100% - 16px) !important;"

descriptionByLocale.it:

In addition, you will act as a technical leader, guiding teams and stakeholders without formal line management responsibility. More about the role
• Define and own the end-to-end data model across connected sensor-based products and software systems
• Design scalable data structures to enable advanced analytics and AI-driven use cases
• Ensure data quality, consistency, traceability and testability across the full data lifecycle
• Provide technical leadership and act as a key point of reference for data modeling and architecture topics
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align data design with product, regulatory, legal and business requirements More about you
• MSc or PhD in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science or a related field
• Background in highly data-driven environments such as banking, finance, insurance or healthcare
• Extensive experience in data modeling and data architecture
• Proven experience designing data models for complex systems, ideally in IoT, sensor or connected device environments
• Strong understanding of data governance, data quality and regulatory requirements (e.g. GDPR, medical devices)
• Ability to lead and influence teams and stakeholders without formal disciplinary responsibility
• Strong communication skills with the ability to bridge technical and business perspectives

sector: MedTech / Hearing care (hearing aids, cochlear implants, consumer hearing)

title: Requirements Engineer

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Sonova, we develop innovative hearing solutions that improve the quality of life for millions of people around the world. To help us create products that are both impactful and reliable, we are looking for a Requirements Engineer who enjoys bringing clarity to complexity and collaborating across diverse teams. In this role, you will act as a key link between engineering, quality, verification, and business stakeholders, ensuring that product requirements are clearly defined, understood, and translated into successful solutions. More about the role
• Define, analyze, and maintain product requirements for innovative hearing solutions
• Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to align on product features, functionality, and expectations
• Create and maintain clear, structured, and testable requirements and specifications
• Ensure requirements comply with internal processes, quality standards, and applicable regulations
• Maintain traceability between user needs, product requirements, test cases, and risks
• Contribute to the continuous improvement of requirements engineering practices, processes, and tools
• Participate in project development teams and support the successful delivery of new product features More about you
• Engineering degree or equivalent technical education
• Further education or training in Requirements Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related field
• 2+ years of experience in product development, ideally in a Requirements Engineering or similar role
• Experience defining, documenting, and managing requirements throughout the product development lifecycle
• Understanding of hardware and/or software development processes
• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, ensuring collaboration within cross-functional teams
• Adaptable, collaborative, proactive, and a strong team player
• Fluent English skills, both written and spoken Nice to have
• IREB Foundation Level, INCOSE, or similar certification
• Experience in regulated industries and/or medical device development
• Familiarity with tools such as Polarion, Jira, Confluence, and MS Teams
• German language skills More about what we offer As one of the world’s leading hearing care providers headquartered in Switzerland, we are committed to building an inclusive culture where you can balance a successful career with your life outside of work through our flexible hybrid working model. We offer a wide range of training opportunities for both professional and personal development, with strong growth opportunities supported by individual development plans. Application process Magdalena Suszek, Talent Acquisition Partner, is looking forward to receiving your application via our online job application platform, including your CV, design portfolio, and cover letter. For this vacancy, only direct applications will be considered. <div dir="auto" style=" width:calc(100% - 16px) !important;"

descriptionByLocale.it:

• Contribute to business decisions across strategy, product development, pricing, marketing, and commercial execution

• Monitor global business performance, analyzing sales, pricing, and financial data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities
• Capture and share commercial best practices across markets to drive continuous improvement
• Lead and execute cross-functional business development projects, ensuring alignment and timely delivery Your profile

• 5–10 years of experience in a commercial, strategy, consulting, or similar role
• Solid understanding of commercial processes, ideally with exposure to sales or local marketing execution
• Proven ability to manage and influence multiple stakeholders across functions and markets, excellent communication and presentation skills
• Experience in project leadership and working in cross-functional, international environments
• Fluent English; additional languages are a plus
• Strong team player with a collaborative mindset What We Offer As one of the world’s leading hearing care providers headquartered in Switzerland, we’re committed to building an inclusive culture. descriptionByLocale.it:
The Director, Performance Management & Capabilities Building is a strategic leader responsible for defining and executing Sonova’s global learning, performance management, and talent development strategies. This role oversees the design and implementation of the Academies framework, coaching and mentoring programmes—including AI-enabled approaches—graduate development, and scalable learning offerings that build organisational capability at all levels. Accountable for shaping and embedding a robust performance management framework, this role partners closely with senior leaders to drive goal setting and talent development for Sonova’s Top 200+ leaders, ensuring alignment with business priorities and leadership standards. The Director leads flagship talent development programmes, individual career journey design, and the talent review process, fostering a culture of continuous growth and high performance. This role ensures integration and alignment of learning and performance initiatives with broader talent functions such as talent acquisition, culture transformation, and Org E&E. The Director also collaborates with HR Strategy to develop and maintain a comprehensive skills architecture and taxonomy that supports Sonova’s evolving capability needs. In this role, you will: Lead Learning and Academies
• Define, develop, and oversee the global Academies framework and its implementation to build critical capabilities across Sonova.
• Design and deliver coaching and mentoring programmes, incorporating AI-enabled tools and approaches to enhance learning effectiveness.
• Manage graduate programmes and scalable learning offerings to support talent development at all organisational levels. Drive Performance Management Framework
• Own and continuously evolve Sonova’s performance management framework, ensuring alignment with organisational goals and leadership expectations.
• Lead goal-setting processes for the Top 200 leaders, fostering accountability and clear performance expectations.
• Partner with HR and business leaders to embed performance management practices that drive high performance and development. Talent Development and Career Journey Design
• Lead the design and execution of individual career journeys for Sonova’s Top 200 talent, supporting personalised growth and succession planning.
• Oversee flagship talent development programmes, including approach design, assessment methodologies, and delivery.
• Develop and implement people leadership standards and related development programmes to strengthen leadership capabilities across the organisation. Talent Review and Succession Processes
• Manage the talent review approach and processes, ensuring robust assessment and calibration of talent across business units.
• Collaborate with HR Strategy and Org E&E team to align talent development efforts with organisational capability needs and succession plans. Skills Architecture and Taxonomy
• Partner with HR Strategy to develop, maintain, and evolve a comprehensive skills architecture and taxonomy that supports workforce planning and capability building.
• Ensure skills frameworks are integrated into learning, performance management, and talent development initiatives. Stakeholder Engagement and Collaboration
• Work closely with business leaders, HR Business Partners, and the Talent Centre of Excellence to ensure learning and performance strategies are aligned with business priorities.
• Collaborate with external partners, including business schools and learning providers, to enhance programme quality and innovation.
• Manage vendor relationships and oversee quality management systems for external learning and assessment providers. Innovation and Continuous Improvement
• Champion a culture of continuous learning and development, leveraging digital and multimedia solutions to maximise reach and impact.
• Monitor and evaluate the effectiveness, adoption, and compliance of learning and performance programmes, using data to drive improvements.
• Stay abreast of industry trends and best practices to ensure Sonova remains a leader in leadership development and talent management. Your Profile:
• 12+ years of progressive leadership experience in global learning, leadership development, and performance management, with a proven track record of designing and scaling high-impact talent development programmes in complex, matrixed organisations.
• Master’s degree in Psychology, Human Resources, Business, or a related field; formal training or qualification in talent development or coaching is highly desirable.
• Ability to develop and execute integrated learning and performance strategies that align with business objectives, drive organisational transformation, and foster a culture of continuous development and high performance.
• Deep knowledge of leadership models, coaching methodologies (including AI-enabled coaching), and talent development frameworks, with experience leading flagship programmes for senior and emerging leaders.
• Strong analytical skills with expertise in leveraging learning analytics, programme evaluation, and performance data to inform strategy, optimise learning experiences, and demonstrate measurable business impact.
• Exceptional stakeholder management and internal consulting skills, with a proven ability to influence senior executives and cross-functional leaders, champion change initiatives, and navigate organisational complexity with agility and resilience.
• Skilled in designing blended learning solutions that incorporate digital, experiential, and social learning modalities at scale, utilising cutting-edge technologies and platforms to enhance engagement and accessibility.
• Experience leading diverse, geographically dispersed teams and programmes across multiple regions (EMEA, Americas, APAC), with sensitivity to cultural nuances and local market dynamics.
• Proven capability in managing budgets, vendor relationships, and quality assurance processes to deliver cost-effective, scalable, and compliant learning and performance management solutions.
• Expertise in learning management systems (e.g., SuccessFactors) and other digital tools that support learning analytics and talent development
• Outstanding communication, presentation, and facilitation skills, capable of engaging and inspiring audiences at all organisational levels, from store sales employees to C-suite executives
• Proven experience designing and implementing diversity, equity, and inclusion initiatives within learning and talent development strategies to build inclusive leadership capabilities.
• Experience working within a corporate headquarters environment, collaborating closely with HR Centres of Excellence, business leaders, and external partners such as business schools and learning providers
• English is a must; proficiency in multiple languages is an asset. More about what we offer As one of the world’s leading hearing care providers headquartered in Switzerland, we’re committed to building an inclusive culture. We want to create an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work, through our flexible hybrid working model. We offer a wide range of training opportunities for both your professional and personal development, and there are exceptional growth opportunities with individual development plans. For this vacancy, only direct applications will be considered. <div dir="auto" style=" width:calc(100% - 16px) !important;"

title: Director Customer Support

descriptionByLocale.it:
About Sonova Sonova is a global leader in innovative hearing care solutions: from personal audio devices and wireless communication systems to audiological care services, hearing aids and cochlear implants. Sonova operates through 3 businesses - Hearing Instruments (Wholesale + Retail), Consumer Hearing and Cochlear Implants – and the core brands Phonak, Unitron, AudioNova, Sennheiser (under license) and Advanced Bionics as well as recognized regional brands. The Group’s globally diversified sales and distribution channels serve an ever-growing consumer base in more than 100 countries. In financial year 2024/205, Sonova Group achieved consolidated sales of over CHF 3.8 billion with adjusted EBITA of CHF 807.8 million. About the role The Director Customer Support is globally responsible for designing, standardizing, and continuously improving the customer service framework. Acting as Global Process Owner, this role defines the support models, structures, and governance that enable regions and countries to deliver accessible, predictable, and customer-friendly service. By balancing global consistency with local flexibility, the Director ensures customer service is scalable, efficient, and positioned as a differentiator for Sonova. This role champions service excellence and empowers customer-facing teams worldwide to deliver seamless experiences that increase satisfaction, loyalty, and efficiency. Key responsibilities: Global Process Ownership & Governance
• Define and govern global customer service processes, including escalation models, response standards, and knowledge management frameworks.
• Build global SOPs, playbooks, and standard work to ensure consistent service across all markets.
• Act as Global Process Owner, accountable for end-to-end customer service delivery and performance across regions. Support Model Design & Optimization
• Design and optimize support structures (e.g., tiered models, remote vs. field service, multilingual capabilities) to balance scale, cost, and customer satisfaction.
• Partner with local and regional leaders to adapt models for market-specific needs while protecting global standards.
• Ensure support models are scalable and flexible to address future growth and changing customer expectations. Service Excellence & Culture
• Drive a customer-centric service culture, embedding excellence into daily operations through training, coaching, and performance management.
• Provide global playbooks, best practices, and frameworks that enable customer-facing roles to deliver consistently high-quality service.
• Act as role model and champion for customer-first mindset across service teams worldwide. Performance & KPI Framework
• Establish, track, and govern global KPIs for customer service (e.g., First-Time Resolution, Time to Respond, Service Satisfaction, Complaint Resolution).
• Provide transparent reporting and dashboards that support global oversight and local accountability.
• Partner with local leaders to analyze results, identify performance gaps, and implement improvement actions. Scalability & Infrastructure
• Build scalable capabilities for customer service delivery, ensuring systems, tools, and processes are aligned across markets.
• Partner with IT and Digital to deploy knowledge management platforms, automation, and AI-powered solutions that reduce manual work and improve responsiveness.
• Continuously enhance efficiency and cost-effectiveness while safeguarding service quality. About you
• University degree in business administration, project management, marketing, communications or related field.
• 8–10 years in customer service leadership with global or multi-market scope.
• Exceptional customer-orientation and a strong background in support model design and optimization, balancing global consistency with local flexibility.
• Demonstrable experience in leading and designing customer support / service strategies and integrating new solutions (digital, AI) to automate and enhance service.
• Strategically thinker with strong analytical/problem-solving skills.
• Entrepreneurial mindset, including a high tolerance for ambiguity and penchant for experimentation.
• Pronounced hands-on mentality and bias towards action.
• Strong continuous improvement mindset and capability to develop and improve processes whilst juggling competing project timelines.
• Ability to effect change, leading people, process, and technology in a dynamic and complex operating environment.
• A proactive collaborator who enjoys working across functions and leading others indirectly within a matrixial organization.
• Strong stakeholder management with a proven ability to influence leadership up to CxO level. <div dir="auto" style=" width:calc(100% - 16px) !important;"

title: Teamleader Support Specialist (m/f/d)

descriptionByLocale.it:
Deine Rolle bei uns In dieser Funktion bist du die fachliche Führung im Support-Team der Elektronikproduktion (m/w/d) und die personelle Führung als Stellvertreter in der Abwesenheit des Teamleiters. Dein Arbeitsalltag bewegt sich direkt an unseren Surface Mount Technology (SMT)-Linien und im Umfeld der Automated Optical Inspection (AOI). Du unterstützt den stabilen Produktionsbetrieb, bist eine wichtige Ansprechperson auf dem Shopfloor und bringst dein technisches Verständnis sowie deine Erfahrung aktiv in die Weiterentwicklung unserer Prozesse ein. More about the role
• Fachliche Unterstützung und Koordination der Mitarbeitenden (m/w/d) im Produktionsalltag sowie Stellvertretung des Teamleiters bei Abwesenheit
• Aktive Mitarbeit im laufenden Betrieb der Surface Mount Technology (SMT)
• Unterstützung, Bedienung und Absicherung der Automated Optical Inspection (AOI) inklusive Pausenablösungen und Springerfunktion
• Analyse von Störungen und erste Maßnahmen zur Behebung in enger Zusammenarbeit mit technischen Schnittstellen
• Organisation von Schichtübergaben sowie Mitarbeit im Daily Management (Tier Meeting)
• Aktive Beteiligung an Continuous-Improvement-, 5S- und Kaizen-Aktivitäten
• Sicherstellung eines klaren Informationsflusses und Durchführung von Gemba-Rundgängen More about you
• Abgeschlossene anerkannte Berufsausbildung im technischen oder industriellen Umfeld
• Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Elektronikproduktion, idealerweise im Umfeld der Surface Mount Technology (SMT)
• Vertraut im Umgang mit Automated Optical Inspection (AOI) und den zugehörigen Produktionsprozessen
• Ausgeprägtes Qualitätsbewusstsein und strukturierte Arbeitsweise
• Teamorientierte Persönlichkeit (m/w/d) mit Freude an fachlicher Verantwortung
• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, Englischkenntnisse von Vorteil
• Programmierung Kenntnisse und IPC Zertifikat von Vorteil More about what we offer Als eines der weltweit führenden Unternehmen im Bereich Hörlösungen mit Hauptsitz in der Schweiz legen wir großen Wert auf eine inklusive und wertschätzende Unternehmenskultur. Wir bieten dir:
• Flexible Anstellungsmöglichkeiten (80–100 %)
• Strukturierte Einarbeitung sowie gezielte interne und externe Weiterbildungen
• Individuelle Entwicklungs- und Wachstumsmöglichkeiten
• Ein modernes Produktionsumfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen
• Die Möglichkeit, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und Prozesse aktiv mitzugestalten <div dir="auto" style=" width:calc(100% - 16px) !important;"

title: Requirements Engineer

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Sonova, we develop innovative hearing solutions that improve the quality of life for millions of people around the world. To help us create products that are both impactful and reliable, we are looking for a Requirements Engineer who enjoys bringing clarity to complexity and collaborating across diverse teams. In this role, you will act as a key link between engineering, quality, verification, and business stakeholders, ensuring that product requirements are clearly defined, understood, and translated into successful solutions. More about the role
• Define, analyze, and maintain product requirements for innovative hearing solutions
• Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to align on product features, functionality, and expectations
• Create and maintain clear, structured, and testable requirements and specifications
• Ensure requirements comply with internal processes, quality standards, and applicable regulations
• Maintain traceability between user needs, product requirements, test cases, and risks
• Contribute to the continuous improvement of requirements engineering practices, processes, and tools
• Participate in project development teams and support the successful delivery of new product features More about you
• Engineering degree or equivalent technical education
• Further education or training in Requirements Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related field
• 2+ years of experience in product development, ideally in a Requirements Engineering or similar role
• Experience defining, documenting, and managing requirements throughout the product development lifecycle
• Understanding of hardware and/or software development processes
• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, ensuring collaboration within cross-functional teams
• Adaptable, collaborative, proactive, and a strong team player
• Fluent English skills, both written and spoken Nice to have
• IREB Foundation Level, INCOSE, or similar certification
• Experience in regulated industries and/or medical device development
• Familiarity with tools such as Polarion, Jira, Confluence, and MS Teams
• German language skills More about what we offer As one of the world’s leading hearing care providers headquartered in Switzerland, we are committed to building an inclusive culture where you can balance a successful career with your life outside of work through our flexible hybrid working model. We offer a wide range of training opportunities for both professional and personal development, with strong growth opportunities supported by individual development plans. Application process Magdalena Suszek, Talent Acquisition Partner, is looking forward to receiving your application via our online job application platform, including your CV, design portfolio, and cover letter. For this vacancy, only direct applications will be considered. <div dir="auto" style=" width:calc(100% - 16px) !important;"

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione In un mondo senza suono, il nostro lavoro acquista un senso. Come parte della nostra organizzazione, garantiamo la qualità e la conformità dei materiali consegnati e supportiamo i processi di produzione. Insieme, creiamo soluzioni che migliorano i nostri processi e garantiscono la qualità dei nostri prodotti. Aiutaci ora a mantenere i nostri elevati standard di qualità. Mansioni - Disimballaggio e preparazione professionale dei materiali consegnati per la lavorazione e i controlli di qualità - Avvio e documentazione di serie speciali per l'approvazione di materiali o lotti - Esecuzione del processo ISIR (Initial Sample Inspection Report) compresa la documentazione associata - Controlli di qualità secondo le specifiche e monitoraggio del rispetto delle norme interne - Garanzia della gestione professionale di materiali non conformi (blocco, etichettatura) - Reimballaggio e etichettatura dei materiali consegnati con dimensioni di imballaggio diverse - Supporto attraverso l'utilizzo e la gestione del tavolo MODI e creazione di ticket SNOW, gestione NC e segnalazioni Q in SAP
• Requisiti - Formazione di base in un campo tecnico o relativo alla qualità o esperienza professionale rilevante nel settore MedTech o farmaceutico - Conoscenze avanzate nel campo della qualità e esperienza nella garanzia della qualità (ad es. tecnica di misurazione, specialista in qualità) - Capacità di lavorare in team, affidabilità e apertura, nonché una marcata autocoscienza con focus sul miglioramento continuo - Pensiero orientato alla qualità e alla gestione aziendale - Tedesco parlato e scritto (leggere e comprendere), conoscenze di base dell'inglese - Utilizzo sicuro di MS Office e SAP (WMS/MM) - EFZ o certificati come SAQ ispettore di qualità sono un vantaggio - Flessibile e resiliente, anche in situazioni impegnative e frenetiche
• Cosa offriamo Come uno dei leader mondiali nel campo della salute uditiva con sede in Svizzera, ci impegniamo a costruire una cultura aziendale inclusiva. In questo ruolo, assumi una grande responsabilità e hai l'opportunità di svilupparti continuamente. Lavori su compiti vari e ottieni una visione di diversi settori, rendendo la tua giornata lavorativa varia e interessante. Inoltre, offriamo un'ampia gamma di opportunità di formazione e sviluppo per la tua crescita professionale e personale, nonché eccezionali opportunità di crescita con piani di sviluppo individuali. Contatto Magdalena Suszek, Talent Acquisition Partner, è felice di ricevere la tua candidatura completa tramite la nostra piattaforma di candidatura online.

Description In a life without sound, our work makes sense. As part of our organization, we ensure the quality and conformity of delivered materials and support production processes. Together, we create solutions that improve our processes and guarantee the quality of our products. Support us now in maintaining our high quality standards.
• Responsibilities - Unpacking and professional preparation of delivered materials for further processing and quality inspections - Initiation and documentation of special series for the approval of materials or batches - Execution of the ISIR process (Initial Sample Inspection Report) including associated documentation - Quality inspections according to specifications and monitoring of compliance with internal regulations - Ensuring the proper handling of non-conforming material (blocking, labeling) - Repackaging and labeling of delivered materials with deviating packaging sizes - Support through operation and maintenance of the MODI table as well as creation of SNOW tickets, NC processing, and Q notifications in SAP
• Requirements - Basic training in a technical or quality-related field or relevant professional experience in the MedTech or pharmaceutical sector - Advanced knowledge in quality management and experience in quality assurance (e.g., measurement technology, quality specialist) - Teamwork, reliability, and openness, as well as pronounced self-reflection with a focus on continuous improvement - Quality-oriented and business-minded thinking - German spoken and written (reading & understanding), basic English skills - Confident handling of MS Office and SAP (WMS/MM) - EFZ or certificates like SAQ quality inspector are an advantage - Flexible and resilient, even in demanding and hectic situations
• What we offer As one of the world's leading companies in the field of hearing health with headquarters in Switzerland, we are committed to building an inclusive corporate culture. In this role, you take on high responsibility and have the opportunity to continuously develop yourself. You work on varied tasks and gain insights into different areas, making your workday diverse and exciting. Additionally, we offer a wide range of training and development opportunities for your professional and personal growth, as well as exceptional growth opportunities with individual development plans. Contact Magdalena Suszek, Talent Acquisition Partner, looks forward to receiving your complete application through our online application platform.
